mode: image2image (vanilla CSFF card art as style reference)
prompt:
Use the attached reference images, each for one purpose.
Reference image 1 is a style reference only: match its flat posterized colour fills, thin dark ink outlines, small ink tick marks and muted palette; do not copy its subject.
Reference image 2 is the SCENE to keep: draw exactly this same beach, keeping its grey overcast sky with flat cloud bands, the calm grey sea on the left with a thin white line of surf, the dark wooded headland in the distance, the wide pale tan sand, the dune grass on the right, the bleached white driftwood branch lying in the lower right and the scattered dark grey stones in the foreground, in the same layout and camera position. Change only this: remove the outrigger canoe, its float, its paddles and the wooden post completely. Where the canoe was there is only smooth empty sand.
Subject: an empty wide beach of pale sand where the land runs out, open grey sea stretching away to the horizon, driftwood and a few stones, no boat of any kind.
The sand is smooth and untouched: no footprints, no tracks, no drag marks, no prints of any kind.
Style: Card Survival Fantasy Forest game card art. Flat posterized colour fills in a few hard-edged tonal steps, cel-like, no soft gradients, no watercolour bleed, no paper texture. Thin dark ink outlines and small ink hatch and tick marks for texture. Muted naturalistic palette. Realistic proportions, nothing glossy, no fantasy glow. The painted scene reaches every edge of the frame. No text, no watermark, no signature, no border, no frame.
Avoid: canoe, boat, outrigger, raft, paddle, oar, wooden post, stake, rope, footprints, tracks, prints or marks in the sand, drag marks, birds, gulls, people, photo, photorealistic, 3D render, anime, pixel art, neon colours, lens flare, watercolour, soft gradients, text, watermark, signature, logo, border, frame, plain white background, vignette, white border.
note: Owner-approved 2026-10-10 in the Card Art Redo Review (second round, redrawn from the owner's notes on the first). Finished by /process-card-art --full-bleed.
